title: carex muricata var. densa
intro: Carex muricata var. densa, commonly known as the "dwarf hair sedge", is a plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is native to North America and is valued for its medicinal properties. The Carex muricata var. densa plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
